bugs.title: Desktop VEC video flickers to song artwork during unstable clips
bugs.symptom: Some desktop VEC clips flash between video and the song artwork underneath during unstable playback or clip handoff.
working_comparisons: Two other tested songs without flicker
bugs.root_cause: Video ownership could become temporarily ambiguous during startup, stall recovery, or handoff, exposing the desktop artwork background before a replacement video was stably playing.
bugs.fix_summary: Keep the desktop artwork background suppressed for the full period the video system owns the stage, including recovery and handoff, and reassert the lock against competing style mutations.
bugs.future_repair: Inspect desktop video ownership, desktopVideoArtworkLock, watchdog state, and stage background mutations before changing a song recipe or special-casing an asset.

bugs.title: Plays do not persist and 10-second play events are not recorded
bugs.symptom: Song plays were not reliably retained, including the intended qualifying play event after 10 seconds of actual listening.
affected_examples: DEV V2 mobile qualified play tracking
DEV V2 clean desktop qualified play tracking
working_comparisons: Expected exactly one total_plays increment after 10 seconds of actual listening
bugs.root_cause: The active V2 runtimes had no deterministic single owner responsible for accumulating 10 seconds of real listening and persisting exactly one play_start event. The backend already accepts play_start and exposes total_plays.
bugs.fix_summary: A dedicated v2-play-tracker.js now owns the 10-second threshold, pauses timing during pause/buffering/seeking, prevents repeat writes after qualification, loads directly on mobile and clean desktop, parses the persisted total_plays response, and updates visible play-count nodes. Live mobile/desktop exact +1 verification remains pending, and backend session-level retry idempotency is not yet proven.
bugs.future_repair: Do not add another play writer. Verify one session end to end through the 10-second threshold, one /radio/track request, exactly +1 total_plays readback, pause/resume, seeking, mobile, and desktop. Add server-side session idempotency if retry ambiguity remains.

bugs.title: Desktop VEC media flickers and video does not trigger
bugs.symptom: Desktop VEC playback can flicker between song artwork, graphics, and video states, while intended VEC videos fail to trigger or start. On Firefox desktop, song graphics may also fail to appear and VEC videos may neither appear nor start.
affected_examples: Firefox desktop missing graphics and videos on 2026-08-17
bugs.root_cause: The accumulated legacy desktop enhancement stack had multiple independent VEC/watchdog/rescue/observer systems mutating the same player and stage. The clean desktop runtime reduces this to one VEC renderer and stage owner.
bugs.fix_summary: Marked Fixed at the user's direction on 2026-08-18 after the clean desktop VEC architecture and cross-browser stability work, and explicitly verified by the user on 2026-08-18.
bugs.future_repair: If the issue returns, start from the clean desktop runtime. Do not restore legacy MutationObserver/watchdog/rescue systems; use exact live-build verification and cross-browser playback diagnostics.

bugs.title: Desktop clean runtime removes login and account interface
bugs.symptom: Desktop users lose the User ID/password login entry point and account/session interface after routing into the clean desktop runtime.
working_comparisons: Standard V2 runtime with auth/session/profile stack
bugs.root_cause: The desktop clean runtime omitted both the .v2-header-actions mount point and the auth/session/profile scripts, so the login control had nowhere to mount and auth UI never initialized.
bugs.fix_summary: Initial repair restores the desktop header action slot and existing auth/session/profile CSS and scripts while preserving the clean desktop VEC/audio runtime.
bugs.future_repair: If desktop login disappears again, verify desktop routing target, header ownership, auth runtime, and recovery rendering before changing Cognito or backend auth.

bugs.title: Desktop login disappears after boot and notifications do not work
bugs.symptom: On desktop, the Log In control briefly appears during initial paint and then disappears after the app finishes booting. The Notifications control is also nonfunctional.
affected_examples: DEV V2 desktop header after full boot
bugs.root_cause: The desktop clean runtime and recovery renderer both participate in header rendering. Recovery can replace #v2App after startup, discarding controls initialized earlier; notification behavior also depended on runtime wiring tied to controls inside the recoverable app container.
bugs.fix_summary: No verified fix yet. Multiple repair attempts have not resolved the user-visible symptom.
bugs.future_repair: Verify the exact live boot path and ensure account and notification controls are owned outside the recovery-rendered app container or otherwise survive all recovery renders. Test full boot, auth sheet opening, account state, notification sheet opening, and live notification loading.
